items.q:

ctx.x:
Now, we are wailing and people are coming from
downstairs up there to see what these turkeys doing up
there.

After a while, there was one cat up there named
Huey. He had a union. He told me, you going through the union,
and he told me, said, you going through the union, said I've gone to the union, and he said, you quit your union and join my union and we gonna run you out of here if you don't join this union.
